summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs detects platform/arch/musl, downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute a locally-shipped file math_init.js at npm install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line file with a rotating string-array decoder (function WV8StW shifting a large numeric/hex constant array n7gIxM) and a '// @bun @bun-cjs' header, i.e. a heavily obfuscated Bun-only payload. The package presents itself as an eslint config (index.js and rules/ contain plausible-looking lint configuration as cover), which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an opaque bundled payload on installation. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern (using a freshly downloaded non-Node runtime to run a sibling file) is used to run code outside the visibility of Node-based supply-chain scanners. The payload runs automatically on any 'npm install' of this package, on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
